## Load data


```{r load_data}
sm_data = read_csv('Data/Renal_Analysis_Data.csv')
sm_data = sm_data%>%arrange(STUDY)
table(sm_data$STUDY)

# Remove late deaths in TRACT trial
sm_data$Died[sm_data$STUDY=='TRACT' & sm_data$Time_to_death>28]=0

# impute weight based on age
table(Age_missing=is.na(sm_data$Age), Weight_missing=is.na(sm_data$Weight_kg))
sm_data$SITEID=as.factor(sm_data$SITEID)
sm_data$COUNTRY=as.factor(sm_data$COUNTRY)

sm_data$Lactate = sm_data$`Lactic Acid_mmol_L`
sm_data = sm_data%>% select(-`Lactic Acid_mmol_L`)
sm_data$Lactate = ifelse(sm_data$Lactate>50,NA,sm_data$Lactate)
```

## Variables in dataset

### Hemoglobin-Hematocrit

```{r}
sm_data$HCT = sm_data$`Hematocrit_%`
sm_data$Hb = sm_data$Hemoglobin_g_L/10
sm_data = sm_data %>% select(-Hemoglobin_g_L, -`Hematocrit_%`)
sm_data %>% ggplot(aes(x=Hb))+geom_histogram(binwidth = .1)+
  xlab('Hemoglobin (g/dL)')+theme_minimal()
sm_data %>% ggplot(aes(x=HCT))+geom_histogram(binwidth = .1)+
  xlab('Hematocrit (%)')+theme_minimal()


sum(!is.na(sm_data$HCT) & !is.na(sm_data$Hb))
sm_data %>% ggplot(aes(x=Hb, y = HCT,colour = STUDY))+geom_point()+geom_smooth(aes(group=NA),method=lm)
mod1 = MASS::rlm(HCT~Hb, data = sm_data)
mod2 = MASS::rlm(Hb~HCT, data = sm_data)
coef(mod1)[2]
1/coef(mod2)[2]

table(is.na(sm_data$HCT) | is.na(sm_data$Hb))
table(is.na(sm_data$HCT) & is.na(sm_data$Hb))
# imputation just using 3x rule
ind = which(is.na(sm_data$HCT) & !is.na(sm_data$Hb))
length(ind)
sm_data$HCT[ind] = 3 * sm_data$Hb[ind]

ind = which(!is.na(sm_data$HCT) & is.na(sm_data$Hb))
length(ind)
sm_data$Hb[ind] = sm_data$HCT[ind]/3
table(is.na(sm_data$HCT) | is.na(sm_data$Hb))

```

## Make analysis dataset
```{r}
sm_data_analysis = sm_data %>% 
  filter(Malaria_Positive, !is.na(Died), !is.na(Creatinine_umol_L) | !is.na(BUN))
table(sm_data_analysis$STUDY)
sm_data_analysis_both = sm_data_analysis %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Creatinine_umol_L), !is.na(BUN)) 

rm(sm_data)

aggregate(Age ~ STUDY, data = sm_data_analysis, FUN = quantile)
aggregate(RFSTDTC ~ STUDY, data = sm_data_analysis, FUN = function(x) range(x,na.rm = T))
aggregate(Died ~ STUDY, data = sm_data_analysis, FUN = function(x) round(100*mean(x),1))
```
plotting params

```{r}
sqrt_breaks = c(1,4,9,16,25,36,50,64,81)
breaks <- 10^(-10:10)
minor_breaks <- rep(1:9, 21)*(10^rep(-10:10, each=9))

SEsmooth=F
my_alpha=0.2
bun_limits = c(1,100)
crea_limits = c(10,1000)

mortality_threshold = 0.05
```


map
```{r patient_map}
create_participant_map(DATA_DM= sm_data_analysis, include_ATA = FALSE)
```



Analysis data

```{r analysis_data}
writeLines(sprintf('Analysis data: there are %s patients from %s studies with at least one baseline creatinine or BUN measurement. %s patients have creatinine; %s patients have BUN; %s patients have both.',
                   nrow(sm_data_analysis),
                   length(unique(sm_data_analysis$STUDYID)),
                   sum(!is.na(sm_data_analysis$Creatinine_umol_L)),
                   sum(!is.na(sm_data_analysis$BUN)),
                   sum(!is.na(sm_data_analysis$Creatinine_umol_L) & !is.na(sm_data_analysis$BUN))
))


lyt <- basic_table() %>%
  split_cols_by("STUDY") %>%
  summarize_row_groups() %>%
  analyze("Age", afun = function(x) quantile(x, probs = c(0.25,.5,.75)), format = "xx.x (xx.x - xx.x)")%>%
  analyze(c('Creatinine_umol_L',"BUN"), afun = function(x) sum(!is.na(x)), format = "xx.x")
build_table(lyt = lyt, df = sm_data_analysis)
```



How do the distributions of BUN and creatinine vary across studies in the children?

```{r boxplots}
 sm_data_analysis %>% filter(Weight_kg<30) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=STUDY, y=Creatinine_umol_L)) + geom_boxplot()+
  scale_y_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks,limits=c(1,100))

sm_data_analysis %>% filter(Weight_kg<30) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=STUDY, y=BUN)) + geom_boxplot()+
  scale_y_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks,limits=c(1,100))
```
```{r}
xx=sm_data_analysis %>% group_by(SITEID, STUDY) %>%
  mutate(group_mortality = mean(Died),
         group_n=n(),
         group_median_creatinine=median(Creatinine_umol_L,na.rm=T),
         group_median_bun=median(BUN,na.rm=T)) %>%
  distinct(SITEID, STUDY, .keep_all = T) %>%
  select(SITEID, STUDY, group_mortality, group_n, group_median_creatinine, group_median_bun)
xx %>% ggplot(aes(x=group_median_creatinine, y=group_mortality))+geom_point()+geom_smooth(method = lm)
xx %>% ggplot(aes(x=group_median_bun, y=group_mortality))+geom_point()+geom_smooth(method = lm)

```

```{r Vietnamese_children}
dat = sm_data_analysis %>% filter(STUDY %in% c('Dong Nai'))
table(Creat_na=is.na(dat$Creatinine_umol_L), BUN_na=is.na(dat$BUN))
my_lims = c(1,100)

p1= dat %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Creatinine_umol_L))+geom_histogram()+
  scale_x_continuous(transform='log10') +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks) +
  annotation_logticks(sides='b') + theme_bw()

p2=dat %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=BUN))+geom_histogram()+
  scale_x_continuous(transform='log10') +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks, limits=c(1,100)) +
  annotation_logticks(sides='b') + theme_bw()

p3=dat %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=BUN, y=Creatinine_umol_L))+geom_point()+geom_smooth()+
  scale_x_continuous(transform='log10') +scale_y_continuous(transform='log10') +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks, limits=c(1,100)) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks, limits=c(10,400)) +
  annotation_logticks(sides='lb') + theme_bw()

quantile(dat$BUN,probs = c(0.025,0.975),na.rm = T)
mytitle=paste('Vietnamese children: ',sum(dat$BUN>20,na.rm = T),'/',nrow(dat),' >20mmol/L',sep = '')
mod = gam(Died ~ s(log10(BUN),k=4),data = dat, family = binomial())
p4=predict_gam(mod,tran_fun = gtools::inv.logit,series = "BUN",
               values = list(SITEID= -1, BUN=1:40))%>%
  plot()+ylim(0,1)+ggtitle('Vietnamese children')+
  scale_x_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks,limits=my_lims) +
  annotation_logticks(sides='b')+theme_bw()+xlab('Urea Nitrogen (mmol/L)')+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 10)+geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05)+theme(legend.position="none")

xx=sm_data_analysis_both %>% filter(STUDY=='Dong Nai')
mean(xx$BUN>10)
mean(xx$BUN>20)

grid.arrange(p1,p2)
```

## Lactate mortality model

```{r lactate, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
table(sm_data_analysis$STUDY[!is.na(sm_data_analysis$Lactate)])
binomial_smooth <- function(...) {
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", method.args = list(family = "binomial"), ...)
}

sm_data_analysis%>%ggplot(aes(y=Lactate,x=Hb))+geom_jitter(width = .05, height = 0.05)+geom_smooth()+xlim(2,12)+ylim(0,15)+theme_minimal()+
  xlab('Haemoglobin (g/dL)')+ylab('Lactate (mmol/L)')

sm_data_analysis %>% filter(!is.na(Hb)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Lactate,y=Died,color = Hb<5))+binomial_smooth()+xlim(0,15)+theme_minimal()+
  ylab('Probability of death')+xlab('Lactate (mmol/L)')

sm_data_analysis %>% filter(!is.na(Hb), Hb>5, !is.na(Coma_Final)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Lactate,y=Died,color = as.factor(Coma_Final)))+binomial_smooth()+xlim(0,15)+theme_minimal()+
  ylab('Probability of death')+xlab('Lactate (mmol/L)')

xx=sm_data_analysis %>% filter(!is.na(Hb), !is.na(Coma_Final), Coma_Final==0) 
table(xx$Hb>5)
xx%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Lactate,y=Died,color = Hb<5))+binomial_smooth()+xlim(0,12)+theme_minimal()+
  ylab('Probability of death')+xlab('Lactate (mmol/L)')+
  geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)


xx=sm_data_analysis %>% filter(Hb>5, !is.na(Coma_Final), Coma_Final==0, !is.na(Lactate)) %>% group_by(STUDY) %>% mutate(mean_died=mean(Died))%>%
  ungroup() %>% filter(mean_died>0.02)

aggregate(Died ~ STUDY, data = xx, FUN = mean)
xx%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Lactate,y=Died,color=STUDY))+
  binomial_smooth()+xlim(0,12)+theme_minimal()+
  ylab('Probability of death')+xlab('Lactate (mmol/L)')+
  geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)
```

```{r mortality_models, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
sm_data_analysis$Weight_category = as.factor(sm_data_analysis$Weight_category)
sm_data_analysis$COUNTRY=as.factor(sm_data_analysis$COUNTRY)

sm_creat = sm_data_analysis %>%
  filter(!is.na(Creatinine_umol_L), 
         Malaria_Positive, Coma_Final==0
  ) 
table(sm_creat$STUDY)
dim(sm_creat)
mean(sm_creat$Died)
table(sm_creat$Weight_category)
mod_all = gam(Died ~ s(log10(Creatinine_umol_L), by=Weight_category,k=3)+
                s(COUNTRY, bs='re'), 
              family = 'binomial',data = sm_creat)
p1=predict_gam(mod_all,tran_fun = gtools::inv.logit,series = "Creatinine_umol_L",
               values = list(COUNTRY= -1, 
                             Creatinine_umol_L=10^seq(1.3,2.8,length.out=20),
                             Weight_category = unique(sm_creat$Weight_category))) %>%
  plot(comparison='Weight_category')+ylim(0,.25)+
  scale_x_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks,limits=crea_limits) +
  annotation_logticks(sides='b')+theme_bw(base_size = 20)+xlab('Creatinine (umol/L)')+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 265)+geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)+
  theme(legend.position="none")



sm_bun = sm_data_analysis %>%
  filter(!is.na(BUN), 
         Malaria_Positive,
         Coma_Final==0
  ) 
nrow(sm_bun)
table(sm_bun$Weight_category)
mean(sm_bun$Died)

aggregate(Died ~ Weight_category + (BUN>20), data = sm_bun, FUN = mean)
aggregate(Died ~ STUDY + (BUN>10), data = sm_bun, FUN = function(x) c(round(100*mean(x)), length(x)))
aggregate(Died ~ Weight_category + (BUN>10), data = sm_bun, FUN = function(x) c(round(100*mean(x)), length(x)))

mod_all = gam(Died ~ s(log10(BUN), by=Weight_category)+s(COUNTRY, bs='re'), 
              family = 'binomial',data = sm_bun)
p2=predict_gam(mod_all,tran_fun = gtools::inv.logit,series = "BUN",
               values = list(COUNTRY= -1, 
                             BUN=10^seq(0,2,length.out=20),
                             Weight_category = unique(sm_bun$Weight_category))) %>%
  plot(comparison='Weight_category')+ylim(0,.25)+
  scale_x_log10(breaks = breaks, minor_breaks = minor_breaks,limits=c(2,40)) +
  annotation_logticks(sides='b')+theme_bw(base_size = 20)+xlab('Urea Nitrogen (mmol/L)')+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 20)+geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)+
  theme(legend.position="none")



sm_data_analysis$Lactate = sm_data_analysis$`Lactic Acid_mmol_L`
sm_lactate = sm_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Lactate), Lactate<50,
         Malaria_Positive,
         Coma_Final==0
  ) 
nrow(sm_lactate)
table(sm_lactate$Weight_category)


sm_lactate = sm_lactate%>%group_by(STUDY)%>%
  mutate(n = n()) %>% filter(n>100)
table(sm_lactate$STUDY)
mod_all = gam(Died ~ s(Lactate,by=STUDY), 
              family = 'binomial',data = sm_lactate)
p3=predict_gam(mod_all,tran_fun = gtools::inv.logit,series = "Lactate",
               values = list(COUNTRY= -1, 
                             Lactate=seq(0,15,length.out=20),
                             STUDY=unique(sm_lactate$STUDY))) %>%
  plot()+ylim(0,.25)+
  theme_bw(base_size = 20)+xlab('Lactate (mmol/L)')+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5)+geom_hline(yintercept = mortality_threshold)

grid.arrange(p1,p2,p3, nrow=1)

```

## Half thresholds??


```{r}
sm_data_analysis = sm_data_analysis %>%
  mutate(
    STUDY_Weight = paste(STUDY, Weight_category,sep = '_'),
    Above_BUN_threshold = 
      case_when(!is.na(BUN) & Weight_category=='(0,25]'&BUN>10 ~ 'YES',
                !is.na(BUN) & Weight_category=='(0,25]'&BUN<=10 ~ 'NO',
                !is.na(BUN) & Weight_category=='(25,100]'&BUN>20 ~ 'YES',
                !is.na(BUN) & Weight_category=='(25,100]'&BUN<20 ~ 'NO'),
    Above_Creat_threshold = 
      case_when(!is.na(Creatinine_umol_L) & Weight_category=='(0,25]'&Creatinine_umol_L>(265/2) ~ 'YES',
                !is.na(Creatinine_umol_L) & Weight_category=='(0,25]'&Creatinine_umol_L<=(265/2) ~ 'NO',
                !is.na(Creatinine_umol_L) & Weight_category=='(25,100]'&Creatinine_umol_L>265 ~ 'YES',
                !is.na(Creatinine_umol_L) & Weight_category=='(25,100]'&Creatinine_umol_L<=265 ~ 'NO'))%>%
  arrange(STUDY, Weight_category)


aggregate(Died ~ Above_BUN_threshold + STUDY, data = sm_data_analysis,
          FUN = function(x) c(round(100*mean(x)), sum(x),length(x)))

lyt <- basic_table() %>%
  split_cols_by('STUDY') %>%
  split_cols_by('Weight_category') %>%
  split_rows_by('Above_BUN_threshold')%>%
  summarize_row_groups() %>%
  analyze("Died", afun = function(x) c(sum(x),mean(x)), format = "xx (xx.x%)")
build_table(lyt = lyt, df = sm_data_analysis%>%filter(!is.na(BUN)))

lyt <- basic_table() %>%
  split_cols_by('STUDY') %>%
  split_cols_by('Weight_category') %>%
  split_rows_by('Above_Creat_threshold')%>%
  summarize_row_groups() %>%
  analyze("Died", afun = function(x) c(sum(x),mean(x)), format = "xx (xx.%)")
build_table(lyt = lyt, df = sm_data_analysis%>%filter(!is.na(Creatinine_umol_L)))

```

```{r}
sm_data_analysis_both$Lactate=ifelse(sm_data_analysis_both$`Lactic Acid_mmol_L`>50, NA, sm_data_analysis_both$`Lactic Acid_mmol_L`)

dim(sm_data_analysis_both)

sm_data_analysis_both$STUDY=as.factor(sm_data_analysis_both$STUDY)

mod_both_BUN = gam(Died ~ scale(log10(BUN)) + s(COUNTRY,bs='re') , data = sm_bun , family = 'binomial')

mod_both_crea = gam(Died ~ scale(log10(Creatinine_umol_L)) + s(COUNTRY,bs='re') , data = sm_creat, family = 'binomial')

mod_both = gam(Died ~ scale(log10(Creatinine_umol_L)) + scale(log10(BUN))+ scale(Lactate) + s(STUDY,bs='re') , data = sm_data_analysis_both, family = 'binomial')


exp(coef(mod_both_BUN)[2])
exp(coef(mod_both_crea)[2])
exp(coef(mod_both)[c(2,3,4)])
```
